text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! There you are, Briiiiight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, I look forward to working with you 
today, Lady Pearl♪

Today's rival is Mejiro Bright. A gentle, 
soft-spoken young lady from the 
prestigious Mejiro family.

Her actions and growth both move at her 
own pace. As such, the Junior Class 
miles—which demand precociousness and 
explosive dash speed—seem a bit ill-suited 
for her, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Today, as a representative of the Mejiro 
family, I would be honored to run 
alongside you~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Representing the Family... I see. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Bright, shouldn't a race be a solitary 
contest, rather than a family affair?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A lonely... match?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Out on the track, nobody is going to 
save you. A seeker must always face the 
challenge entirely alone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My father used to be like that, too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"In search of unseen gold—westward, ever 
westward. Overcoming solitude all alone on 
a journey..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And I finally struck it. A gold vein of 
glory. That's the true frontier spirit!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Carrying that same romance in my heart, I 
am reaching for new frontiers too. Ready 
to stake a lifetime on it, if that's what 
it takes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that what it means to be strong? To 
stand on one's own, rather than relying on 
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Howaa~... Yes, indeed~. Perhaps that is 
simply how it is~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Still, as a Mejiro, I have aaaalways 
thought of you as 'Mejiro-san♪', you know~

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I-I see... Well, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Bright is so mild in mind and 
spirit, I can never quite read her 
enthusiasm."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Rumor has it she's still far from 
ready... Is she really someone we need to 
keep that close an eye on?"
choice_data_list: Ah, you might want to be careful.
Yeah, you might want to be careful.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...You're awfully serious. Did you sense 
something from Bright?"

There was one thing on my mind. Mejiro 
Bright's legs were still underdeveloped, 
and rumors said there were concerns, 
but...

Her demeanor while walking through the 
paddock tunnel earlier...

There wasn't the slightest sign of her 
worrying about her legs.

Is it because of her natural laid-back 
nature? Or could it be...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, if you say so, I won't let my guard 
down around her. But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose to family. The one shining 
today will be me, a lonely pearl!
